_meta.what: Filed EPS-numerator adjustments that the SEC companyfacts tags do not carry, read by valuation/eps_tieout.py (RULES.md 29, Kilian 2026-11-23: reported quarters tie to filed EPS to the cent, no tolerance; any override told to Kilian). Per symbol, per quarter end. diluted_adj: $ added to the net income the rebuild divides by diluted shares (negative = the company takes it out), from the filing's own EPS note or footnote. ytd_derived: the filed quarter EPS is the filed year-to-date EPS less the filed earlier quarters' EPS of the same fiscal year, not the quarter's own net loss / shares; eps_tieout checks that arithmetic on the filed figures and the row is marked as an override.

2026-09-26.what: Diluted EPS numerator excludes a $120M gain: mark-to-market on the portion of a derivative liability tied to 5M contingent Escrowed Shares that are included in diluted weighted-average shares (5,307M). 3,320 - 120 = 3,200; 3,200 / 5,307 = 0.603 -> filed 0.60.
2026-09-26.where: Intel Q3 2026 earnings release (8-K exhibit), consolidated condensed statement of operations, footnote 1 to diluted EPS
